subject: FY28 quarter kickoff: proposed OKR slate + exec sign-off
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FY28 quarter kickoff: proposed OKR slate + exec sign-off

Hi all —

Attached is the initial OKR slate I pulled together for the FY28 quarter kickoff. I focused on a tight set of measurable bets we can drive from the platform and product teams to keep the QBR narrative crisp. High level:

- Objective A: Improve inference throughput and cost efficiency
  - KR1: 20% reduction in average token cost (owner: Marcus)
  - KR2: 99th percentile latency under 90ms for hosted API (owner: Lauren)

- Objective B: Enterprise adoption and reliability
  - KR1: 3 enterprise customers migrated to Dedicated (owner: Rishi)
  - KR2: SOC2 continuous control coverage plan rolled out (owner: Laura)

- Objective C: Developer velocity & DX
  - KR1: 40% increase in successful self-serve signups (owner: Kimberly)
  - KR2: Publish 4 reference apps + evaluation harness (owner: Marcus)

Asks: please review the attached FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v1.pdf and the QBR_Runbook_v1.xlsx linked above. I need:
- Core edits or redlines back by EOD Monday (6/4)
- Owners to confirm commitment (reply-all with "+owner" on your KR lines)
- Any major risks/unknowns you want surfaced to execs before QBR

Notes: I nudged targets conservative on spend; Rishi — can you flag any finance constraints? I’ve cc'd Logan to keep the QBR timeline on his radar.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v1.pdf, QBR_Runbook_v1.xlsx

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FY28 quarter kickoff: proposed OKR slate + exec sign-off

On Fri, 1 Jun 2028 at 09:12, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached is the initial OKR slate ...

Thanks, Kim — quick read and a couple of in-line notes. High-level: I like the focus but recommend tightening a couple KR targets and adding a measurable CS health metric under Objective B.

Inline: 
- Objective A — KR1: reduce "average token cost" is fine, but prefer 18% (not 20) to avoid scope creep until we finalize quantization approach.
- Objective A — KR2: 99th percentile latency under 90ms is aggressive for the hosted tier given current traffic distribution; suggest 95ms or add a regional caveat (US-only).
- Objective B — add KR: "Customer-reported severity-1 incidents <=1 per quarter" (owner: Laura or CS).

I can take KR1 owner (through the runtime optimizations and kernel rollout) but will confirm with infra. Marking as +owner for KR1 now.

-Marcus
Senior Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FY28 quarter kickoff: proposed OKR slate + exec sign-off

Kimberly — thank you for assembling. Endorse the high-level slate. A couple asks before I formally sign off: 

- Include a short risk mitigation row per objective (e.g., quantization increases perf but risks minor regression on some LLMs).
- For the QBR narrative, can we include a 1-slide "fallback & escalation" plan for capacity issues and model regressions?

If those are added I can sign off.

Laura Bennett
VP, Product Strategy
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Anna Solis <anna@strategyco.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FY28 quarter kickoff: proposed OKR slate + exec sign-off

Quick note on finance alignment: we need a spend forecast tied to the Dedicated migration and kernel rollouts. Finance (Tina at Acme finance) will want a 3-month and 12-month projection for committed GPU hours and estimated infra cost.

Action items: 
- Kimberly: can you push an updated OKR slate that includes a short cost impact column for each KR?
- Marcus: can you provide a list of the two top kernel rollouts and estimated engineering runway?

Anna — copying the advisory team; if you have any deck framing suggestions for the QBR (customer narrative + ask), please share.

-Rishi
Head of Revenue Operations

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Anna Solis <anna@strategyco.com>, Tina Morales <tina@acme-corp.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v2 and ask for sign-off (EOD)

Thanks for the quick reads — I incorporated Marcus and Laura's notes and added a short cost-impact column and a one-line risk mitigation per objective. See attached FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v2.pdf. Key updates: 

- Adjusted Obj A KR1 to 18% token cost reduction (Marcus +owner confirmed).
- Obj A KR2 latency target relaxed to 95ms (US only).
- Added CS health KR under Obj B: "<=1 S1 per quarter" (owner: Laura).
- Cost-impact column: estimated incremental spend for dedicated pilots = $280k over three months (subject to finance adjustments).

Please reply-all with full sign-off or any remaining redlines by EOD today (6/1). If I don’t hear objections, I’ll mark this as "Exec-endorsed" and we’ll include in the QBR packet.

Attachments: FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v2.pdf

Thanks —
Kimberly

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 17:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FY28_Q3_OKR_Slate_v2 and ask for sign-off (EOD)

+owner for Obj A KR2 (latency) and +signoff from my side. The risk and cost notes look complete to me; good balance of ambition and mitigations.

Lauren Bishop
Head of Product, Platform
Redwood Inference
